description: This file defines the SupplierQuotation class and related functions for handling supplier quotations within an ERP system, including validation, status updates, and conversion to purchase orders or other documents.

classes.name: SupplierQuotation
classes.description: Class representing a supplier quotation, inheriting from BuyingController, with methods for validation, status updates, and related operations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the supplier quotation, including status, items, and date constraints.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions when the supplier quotation is submitted, setting status and updating related RFQ status.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions when the supplier quotation is canceled, updating status and RFQ status.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Placeholder for trash event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: validate_with_previous_doc
methods.description: Validates the quotation against previous documents like Material Request.

methods.name: validate_valid_till
methods.description: Ensures the 'valid_till' date is not before the transaction date.

methods.name: update_rfq_supplier_status
methods.description: Updates the status of related RFQs based on the supplier quotation items.
